products.name: Weights & Biases
products.note: ML experiment tracking, model registry, and artifact lineage; W&B Weave adds LLM and agent tracing, evaluation, and guardrails; acquired by CoreWeave

profile_text.body:
Weights & Biases is an AI developer platform that describes itself as a system of record for training AI models and developing AI applications. The platform is certified under ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 27017:2015, and ISO/IEC 27018:2019, and is compliant with SOC 2 and HIPAA standards; it also helps customers comply with NIST 800-53 and is aligned with GDPR requirements for processing personal information.

The company's core offering covers ML experiment tracking, a model registry, and artifact lineage. Its W&B Weave product adds LLM and agent tracing, evaluation, and guardrails, allowing developers to instrument existing code and surface performance data for generative AI components within the broader platform. Weights & Biases has been acquired by CoreWeave.
